book.name: Matai
book.title: Uruunu ambaiŋana ki Yesu Krisi ta Matai ibeede

content: Zin bibip timbuuru pa Yesu
Yesu iso sua ta boozomen tana ma imap, to iso pizin naŋgaŋ kini ma iso:
“Niom kuute: Malama, to suŋŋana biibi ki Pasoba ipet. Mi Tomtom Lutuunu ko tikami mi tiuri la ka koi bizin naman be tipuni sala ke pambaaraŋana.”
Indeeŋe tana na, zin bibip kizin patoronŋana kan ziŋan zin peeze kan pakan tilup zin lela ruumu ki Kaipas, ta biibi kizin patoronŋana kan na.
Mi tirru zaala keŋana sa pa Yesu be tikami, mi tipuni ma imeete.
Mi tiparso pizin ma tiso: “Irao takami pa mazwaana ki lupŋana biibi taiŋgi pepe. Kokena zin iwal biibi timaŋga mi tikam malmal.”
Moori ta iliŋ ŋgere sala Yesu uteene
Yesu ziŋan naŋgaŋ kini timbotmbot ruumu ki Simon ta kar Betania. Simon tana, muŋgu mbetmbeete sananŋana ikami.
Tikanan kini ma timbotmbot, mi moori ta, ni ikam ŋgere kuziiniŋana ta ka kadoono biibi kat na, mi imar ma iliŋ sala Yesu uteene.
Naŋgaŋ kini tire na, irao lelen som. Tana tiso: “Waii, moori ti ipasaana sorok koroŋ tiŋgi paso!
Ŋgere ti na, ka pat ta sorok som. Be toŋgomoono, so takam pat biibi be tu'uulu zin wal sorrokŋan pa.”
Tamen Yesu iute ŋgar kizin kek. Tana iso pizin ma iso: “Kumbuulu kwoyom pa moori ti paso? Iŋgi ni ikam mbulu ambaiŋana pio.
Zin wal sorrokŋan ko niomŋan kombotmbot ma alok. Mi nio, nako itiŋan tombotmbot ma molo som.
Ŋgere ti, ni iliŋ salakaala yo bekena iurpe yo pa koŋ mete.
Tana nio aŋso kat piom: Kaimer sombe tomtom tisoyaara uruŋ ma irao karkari, inako tiwidit mbol pa mbulu ta ni ikam pio i, bekena tomtom matan kiskis.”
Yudas iyok be iswe Yesu
To naŋgaŋ laamuru mi ru ki Yesu tana, tomtom kizin ta, zaana Yudas Iskariot, ni imaŋga mi ila kizin bibip kizin patoronŋana kan.
Mi iwi zin ma iso: “Lak, nio sombe aŋur Yesu ima nomoyom, nako kakam leŋ sokorei?” To zin tikam pat silba tomoota laamuru ise namaana mi ila.
Tana indeeŋe tina mi ila na, Yudas irru zaala be iur Yesu ila naman.
Yesu ziŋan naŋgaŋ kini tikan Pasoba ka kini
Timbot ma aigule mataana kana ki lupŋana biibi tabe zin Yuda tilup zin mi tikan narabu ta ka yis somŋana i, to naŋgaŋ ki Yesu timar kini mi tiwi i. Tiso: “Lak. Kini ki Pasoba, ko amurpe pu isu swoi?”

Mi ni iso pizin ma iso: “Kelela pa kar biibi, to kere tomtom ta imbotmbot. Koso pini ta kembei. Koso: ‘Mos katuunu tiam iso nol kini igarau kek. Tana leleene be ziŋan naŋgaŋ kini tikan kini ki Pasoba lela ruumu ku.’”
Tana naŋgaŋ kini tito kalŋaana, mi tiparaŋraŋ kini mi koroŋ ta boozomen pa suŋŋana ki Pasoba.
Timbotmbot ma zoŋ isula, to Yesu ziŋan naŋgaŋ kini mbulen isu pa kini kanŋana.
Tikanan ma timbotmbot, mi Yesu isu ma iso pizin. Iso: “Nio aŋso kat piom, tomtom tiom tasa kola iur yo la koŋ koi bizin naman.”
Naŋgaŋ kini tileŋ sua tana na, lelen ipata kat. Mi zin tataŋa timaŋga mi tiwi i. Tiso: “Biibi, sua ku tana, nu so pio?”
Mi ni ipekel kwon ma iso: “Tomtom ta niamru amtizik narabu isula mbooro tamen, ina ni tau.
Tana Tomtom Lutuunu kola tipuni ma imeete. Ka sua imbot pataaŋa kek. Mi tomtom tabe iswe i la ka koi bizin i, na tembeli kek! Naana ra ipeebi som, so ndabok!”
To Yudas tabe iswe i na, imaŋga mi iwi i. Iso: “Biibi, sua ku tana, nu so pio?” Mi Yesu ipekel kwoono ma iso: “Sua ta itum so na.”
Temen pemetŋana
Tikanan ma timbotmbot, mi Yesu ikam narabu ma isuŋ pa, to itette ma irao zin naŋgaŋ kini. Mi iso: “Kakam mi kakan. Iŋgi nio mozoŋ ŋonoono.”
Tona ikam mbooro baen ma isuŋ pa, mi ikam la kizin mi iso: “Is. Niom ta boozomen kakam mi kiwin.
Iŋgi nio siŋiŋ, ta ko ireere ma isu be ireege sanaana kizin tomtom boozomen, mi iwe zaala popoŋana be ziŋan Anutu tiparlup zin ma tiwe tamen.
Nio aŋso kat piom. Nio ko aŋwin baen mini som ma ila indeeŋe ta itiŋan tulup ti su kar ki Tamaŋ, to aŋwin mini baen popoŋana isu tana.”
Tikan makiŋ, to timbo mboe suŋŋana kana ta, mi tizem ruumu mi tisala pa abal Olib.
Yesu iso Petrus ko iwatkaali
To Yesu iso pizin naŋgaŋ kini ma iso: “Mbulu tabe ipet pio pa mbeŋ ta koozi, kola ikam niom ta boozomen ma kotop pa urlaŋana tiom mi kipizil ndemeyom pio. Pa sua ki Anutu imbot pataaŋa kek ta kembei:

content.text: Nio ko aŋpun mboroŋan kizin sipsip,
to zin sipsip ko tiko papirik lup.

content: “Tamen kaimer sombe aŋmaŋga mini pa naala, nako aŋmuuŋgu ma aŋla aŋsa yom su Galilea.”
To Petrus imaŋga ma iso: “Inako zin pakan. Mi nio, nako aŋrao aŋtop mi aŋpizil ndemeŋ pu na som.”
Mi Yesu iso pini ma iso: “Petrus, nio aŋso kat pu. Mbeŋ ta koozi nu kola watkaala zoŋ pa tel, mana man itaŋ.”
Mi Petrus ipekel kwoono ma iso: “Asiŋ iso u? So tipunu, nako tipun yo tomini ma ituru mi temetmeete raraate. Mi irao aŋwatkaala zom na som. Som kat.” Mi zin naŋgaŋ pakan tomini tiso sua raraate men.
Yesu isuŋ su lele Getsemane
Yesu ziŋan naŋgaŋ kini tipa ma tila tipet lele ta, zaana Getsemane. Tona iso pizin ta kembei. Iso: “Mbuleyom isu tiŋgi ma kombotmbot, mi nio aŋlae tiŋga be aŋsuŋ.”
To ikam Petrus mi Zebedi lutuunu bizin ru ma ziŋan tila. Mi Yesu tiŋisŋiizi ikami mi leleene ipata biibi kat.
Tana iso pizin ma iso: “Aiss, leleŋ ipata kat. Leleŋ pataŋana taiŋgi be ipun yo ma aŋmeete i. Tana kapamatmaata raama yo mi itiŋan tombotmbot.”
Ni iso makiŋ, to izem zin ma timbot, mi ipa ma ilae ri. To iŋgun kumbuunu, mi ituundu su toono ma isuŋ. Iso: “O Tamaŋ, irao be tatke mbooro
taiŋgi pio? Iŋgi nio aŋso. Mi nu itum tau.”
Isuŋ makiŋ, mi imiili ma imar, to ire naŋgaŋ kini tel tina tikenne. Tana iso pa Petrus ma iso: “O niom tel, parei? Irao be kapamaata raama yo risa som?
Niom kapamaata mi kusuŋ. Kokena toomboŋana ikam yom to kotop. Pa lelende na, mata leŋleŋ. Mi kulindi na, mburaana irao som.”
To izem zin mi ilae be isuŋ mini ma iwe ru pa. Iso: “Tamaŋ, mbooro ti, sombe lelem be tatke pio som, na toŋgo. Nio ko aŋkam mi aŋwin la. Nu itum lelem tau.”
Isuŋ ma imap, tona imiili ma ila mini. Mi ire naŋgaŋ kini tikenne men. Paso, matan ikam sanaana zin ma tisaana kat.
Tana izem zin, mi ila ma isuŋ mini. Ipoto suŋŋana kini ma iwe tel pa,
tona imiili ma imar mini kizin naŋgaŋ, mi iso pizin ma iso: “Wai! Niom kekenne men? Kamaŋga lak. Pa nol tabe tiur Tomtom Lutuunu ila zin wal sananŋan naman, ta iŋgi ipet kek.
Kamaŋga mi tala. Pa kere. Tomtom ta ila iswe yo la koŋ koi bizin, ta iwwa ma imar i.”
Tikam Yesu ma tila

Yesu izzo sua tina ma imbotmbot, mi Yudas ziŋan zin iwal biibi ta timar raama buza mi zaaba. Wal tana, zin bibip kizin patoronŋana kan ziŋan zin peeze kan pakan kizin Yuda tiŋgo zin ma timar. (Yudas tana, ni tomtom ta ta imbot la Yesu naŋgaŋ kini laamuru mi ru na.)
Mi Yudas isotaara zin kek ta kembei. Iso: “Kere. Tomtom ta sombe aŋbeŋbeeŋe pini, ina ni tau. Kikisi.”
Tana iwal biibi tina tipet to, Yudas ikoŋuru Yesu ma ila, mi iso pini. Iso: “Mos katuunu, mbeŋ ambaiŋana!” To imbeŋbeeŋe pini.
Mi Yesu iso pini ma iso: “Toroŋ, mbulu ti, ta mar pa i?” Iso sua tina, to tikiskisi, mi tikami be tila.
To naŋgaŋ kini ta, ni ipas buza kini, mi ipiri na isap tomtom ta talŋaana ma itop su. Tomtom tana, ni mbesooŋo ki biibi kizin patoronŋana kan.
Tamen Yesu iso pa naŋgaŋ kini tana ma iso: “Hait! Zeebe buza ku tana isula muriini mini. Pa wal boozomen ta titeege buza na, kaimer ko imiili pizin.
Nu ute som? Nio sombe aŋboobo Tamaŋ Anutu be iuulu yo, so loŋa men mi iŋgo aŋela munŋaana ka tieene ma tisu be tiporoukaala yo.
Tamen sombe aŋkam ta kembena, ko sua ki Anutu iur ŋonoono be parei? Pa mbulu ti na, ka sua imbot pataaŋa kek.”

To iso pa iwal biibi tina ma iso: “Wai! Nio ti tomtom malmalŋoŋ sa, ta kamar ramaki buza ma zaaba be kakam yo i? Aigule boozomen ta itiŋan tombotmbot Urum Merere kwoono, mi aŋkamam sua piom na. Parei ta kakam yo pataaŋa som?
Ambai. Toŋgo. Pa mbulu ta boozomen ti bela ipet. Naso sua ta Anutu kwoono bizin tibeede na, iur ŋonoono.” Iso sua tana, to naŋgaŋ kini ta boozomen tizemi mi tiko ma tila len.
Tipamender Yesu isu zin peeze kan keren uunu

Wal ta tikiskis Yesu na, tikami mi tila tiuri lela ruumu ki Kaipas leleene. Kaipas, ni biibi kizin patoronŋana kan. Mi zin ŋgarŋan ki tutu ziŋan zin peeze kan pakan tomini tilup zin su ruumu tina ma timbotmbot.
Mi Petrus, ni itokelkeeli ma ila. Ila ma igarau ruumu tana kwoono, to mbuleene isu, mi ziŋan zin menderŋan timbotmbot mi tirre lae pa Yesu: Ko tikam parei pini?
Mi zin bibip kizin patoronŋana kan ziŋan zin peeze kan ta boozomen titoombo be tiru tomtom pakan be tipombol sua pakaamŋana pa Yesu. Naso iwe le uunu be tipuni pa.
Mi wal boozo timaŋga mi tiŋgal sua pakaamŋana pini. Tamen sua kizin sa indeeŋe som. Tona wal ru timaŋga mi tiso:
“A, niam amleŋ to ti iso ta kembei: ‘Nio aŋrao be aŋreege urum biibi ki Anutu ma isu lene, mi aŋpamender mini pa aigule tel men.’”
To biibi kizin patoronŋana kan imaŋga mi iso pa Yesu ma iso: “Sua ta tigibgiibi pu na, nu rao be pekel som?”
Mi Yesu iso sua sa som. Imaane men. To biibi tana iso pini mini ma iso: “Nio aŋso pu ta kembei: Kozo so kat sua ŋonoono piam ila Anutu mata yaryaaraŋana mataana. Nu Mesia tau Anutu Lutuunu, som som?”
Mi Yesu ipekel kwoono ma iso: “Sua ta itum so na. Mi nio aŋso kat pa niom ta boozomen ta kembei: Kaimer to niom ko kere

content.text: Tomtom Lutuunu, ni mbuleene ise muriini ta imbot la Anutu mbolkeŋkeŋŋana namaana woono. Mi ko kere ni imbot se miiri tieene saamba kana mi imiili ma imar.”

content: Biibi kizin patoronŋana kan ileŋ sua tina na, ipas keteene. To iraaza mburu kini mi iso: “Oo imap! Tana turu tomtom toro sa be iso ka sua paso? Buri na tapas sua ila itunu kwoono i. Niom ituyom kombot mi keleŋi. Ni ipasaana sua pa Anutu kek.
Lak, niom koso parei?” Mi zin tipekel kwoono ma tiso: “Sua sa som. Ina uunu kini tina tabe imeete pa tau.”
Tona tipures la mataana, mi tipuni.
Mi tipeeze paŋaana, mi tipeŋeu i ma tiso: “Nu Mesia mi Anutu kwoono, na? Kena so lak. Asiŋ ta ipunu na?”
Petrus iwatkaala Yesu zaana
Indeeŋe tina, Petrus ni imbutultul ma imbotmbot ruumu kwoono. Mi mbesooŋo moori ta, ni imar kini to iso: “Ai, nu tana tomini, niomru Yesu ta ki Galilea na kawwa.”
Tamen Petrus kwoono imbol mi iso ila iwal biibi matan ta kembei: “Wa! Sua ta zzo i, nio aŋkankaana pa.”
To izem muriini mi ruk ma iperae ŋana ri ma imbotmbot. To moori toro ire i. Mi iso pizin wal ta ziŋan timendernder na, ma iso: “To ti, nio aŋre i ziŋan Yesu ki Nasaret tiwwa.”
Mi Petrus iwatkaali mini, mi kwoono imbol ma iso: “E-e, ŋonoono kat ta kor a, tomtom tana, nio aŋute i som.”
Timbot ri, to zin wal ta timendernder tina, tikoŋuru Petrus ma timar mi tiso: “Wai, nu tina, niomŋan tau. Pa kalŋoyom mbukunbukun raraate.”
Tabe Petrus imaŋga ma kwoono imbol mi iso: “Ŋonoono kat, tomtom ta niom kozzo pini na, nio aŋute i risa som. Sombe aŋpakaam, na Anutu ipasaana yo lak!” Indeeŋe tana na, man itaŋ.
To Petrus mataana ila pa sua ta Yesu iso pini ma iso: ‘Mbeŋ ta koozi, nu kola watkaala zoŋ pa tel, mana man itaŋ.’ Tana iyooto ma ipera mat, mi itaŋ ma iyeryer.

footnotes.text: Mbooro, ina imender pa Anutu kete malmalŋana kini mi sanaana ka kadoono tabe Yesu ibaada i.
